mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, title, last_provider_id AS lastProviderId, last_provider_name AS lastProviderName, last_model_id AS lastModelId, last_reasoning_effort AS lastReasoningEffort, message_count AS messageCount, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_conversation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation SET last_provider_id = #{providerId}, last_provider_name = #{providerName}, last_model_id = #{modelId}, last_reasoning_effort = #{reasoningEffort}, message_count = message_count + #{addedMessages}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_conversation SET title = #{title}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1 FROM ai_conversation_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
SELECT id, role, text, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM ai_conversation_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY seq

SELECT COUNT(*) AS runs, COALESCE(SUM(state = 'SUCCEEDED'), 0) AS succeeded, COALESCE(SUM(state = 'FAILED'), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(state = 'ABORTED'), 0) AS aborted, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens IS NULL AND completion_tokens IS NULL), 0) AS runsWithoutUsage, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(input_chars), 0) AS inputChars, COALESCE(SUM(output_chars), 0) AS outputChars, COALESCE(SUM(duration_ms), 0) AS durationMs FROM ai_chat_run

SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(started_at, '+00:00', #{offset})) AS date, COUNT(*) AS runs, COALESCE(SUM(state = 'FAILED'), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(input_chars), 0) AS inputChars, COALESCE(SUM(output_chars), 0) AS outputChars, COALESCE(SUM(duration_ms), 0) AS durationMs FROM ai_chat_run
GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(started_at, '+00:00', #{offset})) ORDER BY date
